title: It's Only Me
question: What did the man expect to find under the stairs?

meanings.usage: 指用于化装舞会等场合的特殊服饰
可指演出、化装活动等的特定服装，也可指某个时期或地区的传统服饰
常见搭配：be impatient to do sth. 迫不及待做某事；be impatient with sb./sth. 对某人/事不耐烦
除了指床上用品，还可表示薄的片状物，如a sheet of paper一张纸
强调能够产生预期的效果，区别于efficient（高效的，侧重效率）
可形容衣物、家具等让人感觉舒服，也可形容人感觉自在
由动词bake（烘焙）加表示人的后缀-er构成
常见搭配：frighten sb. 吓到某人；frighten sb. into doing sth. 威胁某人做某事
复合名词，由store（储藏）和room（房间）构成
表示电力、电流的不可数名词，相关形容词为electric（电的）
文中指电表，也可作为长度单位“米”，美式拼写为meter
过去式和过去分词为fled，强调因害怕、危险而快速逃离
可作及物或不及物动词，强调关门等动作的力度大、声音响

phrases.usage: 表示“装扮成，打扮成”，用于化装、角色扮演等场景

examples.en: She intended to dress up as a ghost for the party.
examples.zh: 她打算在派对上装扮成鬼魂。

examples.en: Children love dressing up as cartoon characters on Halloween.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在万圣节装扮成卡通人物。

phrases.usage: 表示“试穿（衣物、配饰等）”，是动副短语，宾语为代词时要放在短语中间

examples.en: She was impatient to try the new costume on.
examples.zh: 她迫不及待要试穿那件新的化装服。

examples.en: You should try the shoes on before buying them.
examples.zh: 你买鞋之前应该先试穿一下。

phrases.usage: 表示“由……组成，由……构成”，不用于被动语态和进行时态

examples.en: The costume consisted only of a sheet, but it was very effective.
examples.zh: 这件化装服只用了一张床单做成，但效果非常好。

examples.en: The research team consists of three scientists and two engineers.
examples.zh: 这个研究团队由三名科学家和两名工程师组成。

phrases.usage: 表示“查明，弄清楚”，侧重通过努力、调查等获知事实真相

examples.en: She wanted to find out whether the costume was comfortable to wear.
examples.zh: 她想弄清楚这件化装服穿起来是否舒服。

examples.en: Please find out when the train leaves.
examples.zh: 请查一下火车什么时候开。

phrases.usage: 表示“大叫一声，发出一声叫喊”，let out可表示发出（声音、光等）

examples.en: The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces when he saw the 'ghost'.
examples.zh: 那个男人看到“鬼魂”的时候大叫一声，往后跳了好几步。

examples.en: She let out a cry of surprise when she saw the birthday gift.
examples.zh: 她看到生日礼物的时候发出了一声惊喜的叫喊。

sentences.en: After her husband had gone to work, Mrs. Richards sent her children to school and went upstairs to her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 丈夫去上班后，理查兹夫人把孩子们送去学校，然后上楼到卧室。

sentences.en: She was too excited to do any housework that morning, for in the evening she would be going to a fancy-dress party with her husband.
sentences.zh: 那个上午她兴奋得顾不上做家务，因为晚上她要和丈夫一起去参加一个化装舞会。

sentences.en: She intended to dress up as a ghost and as she had made her costume the night before, she was impatient to try it on.
sentences.zh: 她打算打扮成一个鬼魂。由于头天晚上她已做好了化装服，所以她迫不及待地想试穿一下。

sentences.en: Though the costume consisted only of a sheet, it was very effective.
sentences.zh: 尽管化装服只是一块床单，但效果却非常好。

sentences.en: After putting it on, Mrs. Richards went downstairs.
sentences.zh: 穿上衣服后，理查兹夫人下了楼。

sentences.en: She wanted to find out whether it would be comfortable to wear.
sentences.zh: 她想看看穿上是否舒服。

sentences.en: Just as Mrs. Richards was entering the dining-room, there was a knock on the front door.
sentences.zh: 理查兹夫人刚走进饭厅，前门就传来了敲门声。

sentences.en: She knew that it must be the baker.
She had told him to come straight in if ever she failed to open the door and to leave the bread on the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 她曾告诉他，如果她没有开门，他就直接进来，把面包放在厨房的桌子上。

sentences.en: Not wanting to frighten the poor man, Mrs. Richards quickly hid in the small storeroom under the stairs.
sentences.zh: 理查兹夫人不想吓着那个可怜的人，便迅速躲到了楼梯下的小储藏室里。

sentences.en: She heard the front door open and heavy footsteps in the hall.
sentences.zh: 她听到前门打开了，走廊里传来沉重的脚步声。

sentences.en: Suddenly the door of the storeroom was opened and a man entered.
sentences.zh: 突然，储藏室的门开了，一个男人走了进来。

sentences.en: Mrs. Richards realized that it must be the man from the Electricity Board who had come to read the metre.
sentences.zh: 理查兹夫人意识到这一定是电力公司的抄表员。

sentences.en: She tried to explain the situation, saying
'It's only me', but it was too late.
The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces.
sentences.zh: 那个男人大叫一声，后退了几步。

sentences.en: When Mrs. Richards walked towards him, he fled, slamming the door behind him.
sentences.zh: 当理查兹夫人走向他时，他逃走了，并在身后砰地关上了门。

exercises.prompt: “床单；（一）张/片” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: sheet · /ʃiːt/ · noun · 床单；（一）张/片。除了指床上用品，还可表示薄的片状物，如a sheet of paper一张纸

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：面包师，面包店老板
exercises.explain: baker · /ˈbeɪkə(r)/ · noun · 面包师，面包店老板。由动词bake（烘焙）加表示人的后缀-er构成

exercises.prompt: “现在分词短语可以在句中作状语，说明主句动作发生的原因，相当于原因状语从句” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构
exercises.explain: 现在分词作原因状语：（Not +）现在分词短语, 主句：现在分词的逻辑主语要和主句主语保持一致，表否定时not放在现在分词前面

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces.
options: 一些女人会认为她们的丈夫总会把事情弄好。
在最后一幕中，一个狱卒总是会带着一封信上台，然后递给囚犯。
那个男人大叫一声，后退了几步。
我告诉她，要么我买一台新割草机，要么就让草长着。
exercises.explain: The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces. — 那个男人大叫一声，后退了几步。

source.en: The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces.

grammar.title: 过去完成时
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个动作或时间之前已经完成的动作，强调“过去的过去”
grammar.usage: 常与after, before, by the time等引导的时间状语连用，说明两个过去动作的先后顺序

examples.en: After her husband had gone to work, Mrs. Richards sent her children to school.
examples.zh: 丈夫上班之后，理查兹太太把孩子们送去了学校。

examples.en: She had made her costume the night before, so she was eager to try it on.
examples.zh: 她前一天晚上就做好了化装服，所以迫不及待想要试穿。

grammar.title: too...to... 结构
grammar.definition: 表示“太……以至于不能……”，是一种表达否定含义的结构
grammar.structure: too + 形容词/副词 + to do sth.
grammar.usage: 当主语是不定式的逻辑宾语时，不定式用主动形式表被动含义

examples.en: She was too excited to do any housework that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上她太兴奋了，什么家务都做不进去。

examples.en: The box is too heavy for the little boy to carry.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了，小男孩搬不动。

grammar.title: 现在分词作原因状语
grammar.definition: 现在分词短语可以在句中作状语，说明主句动作发生的原因，相当于原因状语从句
grammar.usage: 现在分词的逻辑主语要和主句主语保持一致，表否定时not放在现在分词前面

examples.en: Not wanting to frighten the poor man, Mrs. Richards quickly hid under the stairs.
examples.zh: 因为不想吓到这个可怜的人，理查兹太太迅速躲到了楼梯底下。

examples.en: Feeling tired, he stopped working to have a rest.
examples.zh: 因为感觉很累，他停下工作休息了一会儿。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be too + 形容词 + to do sth.

original.en: She was too excited to do any housework that morning.
original.zh: 那天早上她太兴奋了，什么家务都做不进去。

examples.en: He was too nervous to say a word in front of the audience.
examples.zh: 他太紧张了，在观众面前一句话都说不出来。

examples.en: The coffee is too hot to drink right now.
examples.zh: 咖啡太烫了，现在没法喝。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + intend to do sth.

original.en: She intended to dress up as a ghost for the fancy-dress party.
original.zh: 她打算在化装舞会上装扮成鬼魂。

examples.en: I intend to travel to Japan with my family this summer holiday.
examples.zh: 我打算今年暑假和家人一起去日本旅行。

examples.en: The company intends to set up a new branch in Guangzhou next year.
examples.zh: 这家公司打算明年在广州开一家新的分公司。

patterns.pattern: Just as + 从句, 主句

original.en: Just as Mrs. Richards was entering the dining-room, there was a knock on the front door.
original.zh: 就在理查兹太太走进餐厅的时候，前门传来了敲门声。

examples.en: Just as I was leaving the house, it started to rain heavily.
examples.zh: 就在我出门的时候，开始下大雨了。

examples.en: Just as he finished his speech, the audience broke into warm applause.
examples.zh: 就在他结束演讲的时候，观众爆发出了热烈的掌声。
